destination_explanation: A satellite this low sweeps across the sky in a few minutes, so a ground station only gets a short window to talk to it on each pass.

slot_b_text: That was SpaceX's 126th launch of the year, 745th all time. That is a launch every other day. No Falcon 9 has failed in 348 flights. It was the 263rd orbital launch attempt worldwide this year.
